description: Create a destination for any platform that gives out an RTMP ingest URL and stream key (Twitch, Facebook, Kick, X, TikTok, Telegram, a self-hosted server, or YouTube when its channel is not connected here). Take rtmpUrl from get_connection_hints(platform).ingestUrl rather than guessing it — a wrong host is a stream that silently never connects. The key is stored encrypted and never read back. Use create_youtube_destination instead when the channel is connected through Streamloop: only then can titles, privacy and thumbnails be managed from here. Attach the new destination to a stream with add_stream_destination.

rtmpKey.description: Stream key from the platform. Stored encrypted.

rtmpUrl.description: Ingest URL. Take it from get_connection_hints(platform).ingestUrl or from the platform's own streaming settings — never invent one.
